spec_match.rationale: Transform uses getPathData({normalize:true}) then setPathData() on the mapped pairs; the optional raw overlay shows the same math producing garbage arcs (e.g. arc radius 338.19) — exactly why normalization exists. Sparkline is built with setPathData from data.

interactive.rationale: Shape select, scale/rotate sliders, flip and naive checkboxes, data field, interpolation select and Build button all drive live output.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Card promises transform + naive comparison + sparkline; delivered.

edge_cases.rationale: Non-numeric data entries ignored and reported, <2 points refused, flat data guarded (span||1); transform honestly 'UNAVAILABLE' without native normalize.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/4787972240179200 plus the SVG Paths spec anchor.

runtime_evidence.rationale: No chrome-devtools-mcp in this environment: verified with Playwright headless Chrome for Testing 153.0.8010.12, default flags and --enable-blink-features=SVGPathDataAPI, desktop 1280x800 and mobile 360x740 DPR3 touch; sliders/checkboxes/selects/data cases exercised; 0 console errors; 0px overflow; mobile screenshot read. Not tested in a default-on build.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts svgpd-transform-native / svgpd-transform-unavailable-honest and svgpd-sparkline-native / svgpd-sparkline-fallback-labelled.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only (shared path-demo.css + small inline blocks); every button override sets both background and color; status chips use emerald-dark/rose on paper/stone; no raw hex.

accessibility.rationale: Native range inputs with <output> labels, checkboxes with labels, figure/figcaption status for the chart, polite debounced status.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Sliders and checkboxes full-width with 44px rows; 0px overflow at 360px.

openQuestions.title: Add a path-reversal operation
openQuestions.detail: Reversing a normalized M/L/C/Z path (per subpath) is a common editor action that becomes simple with normalized data; add it as another transform.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use polite live regions for standard status updates, debounce frequently-changing regions, use role=img + title for non-decorative inline SVG, and provide data tables as alternatives for visual graphics.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Status lines are role=status/aria-live=polite and debounced (250-400ms) where driven by sliders/typing/drag; each SVG has role=img (or role=group for the editor) with a <title>; segment data is always also shown as text/table.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel without horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Collapse multi-column layouts on narrow viewports, set min-width:0 on grid children, and wrap long unbreakable tokens.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Shared path-demo.css: .split/.cases grids collapse to one column below 640-860px, min-width:0 on stage children, overflow-wrap:anywhere on code/output; measured scrollWidth-clientWidth = 0 at 360x740 DPR3 and 1280x800 in both modes.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Charts need a long description (figure/figcaption) or data-table alternative.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The sparkline is a figure whose figcaption (role=status) states point count, range and first-to-last change; the input field holds the raw data.

summary: Built and self-reviewed in a cloud session without chrome-devtools-mcp; evidence is Playwright headless Chrome 153 with and without --enable-blink-features=SVGPathDataAPI.
